name: 3WEBOBS Intent Taxonomy
purpose: Map search and optimization intents across the Human Web and AI-search disciplines to TOF, MOF and BOF.

TOF.name: Top of Funnel
TOF.meaning: Learn, discover, understand, diagnose or explore.

MOF.name: Middle of Funnel
MOF.meaning: Compare, investigate, evaluate, validate or shortlist.

BOF.name: Bottom of Funnel
BOF.meaning: Navigate to a brand, check price, contact, hire, sign up, buy or transact.

intents.example: why is my site not ranking
